## Project guidance
- Keep the localStorage fallback functional when Firebase environment variables are absent.
- Keep delivery records and status typed in `src/types.ts`.
- Follow the existing React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and lucide-react conventions.
- Treat Firestore security rules as required before enabling cloud sync.
